result.instructions: Tools for HubSpot, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which deals are open in the sales pipeline, and in which stage is each one?"; "Find contacts created this month whose company is still empty."; "Update the lifecycle stage of contact 123 to customer.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes HubSpot data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run hubspot_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run hubspot_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run hubspot_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. hubspot_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: hubspot_list_objects
tools.title: List CRM records
tools.description: List contacts, companies, deals or tickets, one page at a time. Pass the returned paging cursor to get the next page. HubSpot API: GET /crm/objects/2026-09/{objectType}.

after.description: Paging cursor: the paging.next.after value from the previous page.

properties.description: Internal property names to return, for example firstname, email.

archived.description: Return archived records instead of active ones (default false).

tools.name: hubspot_get_object
tools.title: Get a CRM record
tools.description: Get one contact, company, deal or ticket by id, with the requested properties and associated record ids. HubSpot API: GET /crm/objects/2026-09/{objectType}/{objectId}.

properties.description: Internal property names to return, for example firstname, email.

associations.description: Associated object types to include, for example companies.

tools.name: hubspot_search_objects
tools.title: Search CRM records
tools.description: Search contacts, companies, deals or tickets with property filters (up to 5 filter groups, 6 filters each, ANDed inside a group and ORed across groups), a sort and a free-text query. Returns up to 200 records per page. HubSpot API: POST /crm/objects/2026-09/{objectType}/search. This only reads data.

query.description: Free-text query across the record's searchable properties.

filterGroups.description: Filter groups. Filters inside a group must all match; any group may match.

propertyName.description: Internal property name to filter on.

value.description: Value to compare. For dates use epoch milliseconds.

sorts.description: One sort, for example { propertyName: 'createdate', direction: 'DESCENDING' }.

properties.description: Internal property names to return, for example firstname, email.

after.description: Paging cursor: the paging.next.after value from the previous page.

tools.name: hubspot_create_object
tools.title: Create a CRM record
tools.description: Create a contact, company, deal or ticket with the given property values. This writes new data to the customer's HubSpot account. HubSpot API: POST /crm/objects/2026-09/{objectType}.

properties.description: Internal property names mapped to string values, for example { "email": "ana@example.com" }.

tools.name: hubspot_update_object
tools.title: Update a CRM record
tools.description: Change the given property values of one contact, company, deal or ticket. Properties not listed keep their values. This changes data in the customer's HubSpot account. HubSpot API: PATCH /crm/objects/2026-09/{objectType}/{objectId}.

properties.description: Internal property names mapped to string values, for example { "email": "ana@example.com" }.

tools.name: hubspot_list_owners
tools.title: List owners
tools.description: List the users who own CRM records (name, email, user id). Use the owner id in the hubspot_ownerid property. HubSpot API: GET /crm/owners/2026-09.

email.description: Return only the owner with this email.

after.description: Paging cursor: the paging.next.after value from the previous page.

tools.name: hubspot_list_pipelines
tools.title: List pipelines
tools.description: List the pipelines and their stages for deals or tickets, with stage ids for filtering and updates. HubSpot API: GET /crm/pipelines/2026-09/{objectType}.

tools.name: hubspot_list_properties
tools.title: List properties
tools.description: List the property definitions of a contact, company, deal or ticket (internal name, label, type, options). Use it to find the internal names before a search or an update. HubSpot API: GET /crm/properties/2026-09/{objectType}.

tools.name: hubspot_read_associations
tools.title: Read associations
tools.description: Read which records of one type are linked to records of another type, for up to 100 source ids per call (for example, the companies linked to some contacts). HubSpot API: POST /crm/associations/2026-09/{fromObjectType}/{toObjectType}/batch/read. This only reads data.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with HubSpot
prompts.description: What you can do with HubSpot here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_deals_by_pipeline_stage
prompts.title: Find deals by pipeline stage
prompts.description: Search deals with property filters, and list the deal pipelines to read the stage names.

prompts.name: find_contacts_with_missing_data
prompts.title: Find contacts with missing data
prompts.description: List the property definitions to find internal names, then search contacts with filters on those properties.

prompts.name: see_which_companies_link_to_contacts
prompts.title: See which companies link to contacts
prompts.description: Read the associations of up to 100 contacts at once, then read the company records by id.

prompts.name: update_a_lifecycle_or_deal_stage
prompts.title: Update a lifecycle or deal stage
prompts.description: Read the record, then update the given property values. Properties you do not list keep their values.

prompts.name: create_a_record_from_a_new_lead
prompts.title: Create a record from a new lead
prompts.description: List the owners to find an owner id, then create a contact, company, deal or ticket with the property values.
